'''Daro Willits''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], spending a great deal of [[Time/Legends|time]] with the socialite [[Sel Maa]] when she visited during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he visited the club and flirted with Maa there when [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] ran in to [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|hide]] from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

==Biography==
[[File:DaroWillits-AotC.png|thumb|right|200px|Daro Willits flirted with Sel Maa at the Outlander Club.]]
Daro Willits was a scruffy [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="IA" /> who visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="sm">{{DB|character|selmaa|Maa, Sel}}</ref> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE2" /> The socialite<ref name="IA" /> [[Sel Maa]] spent a great deal of [[Time/Legends|time]] with<ref name="sm" /> him<ref name="Insider" /> when she visited during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="sm" />

During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Willits came to the club hoping to make an impression.<ref name="Insider" /> He flirted with Maa in a private booth of the club<ref name="IA" /> when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered looking for the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] after a [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|failed assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. The Human<ref name="aotc" /> [[Reha Logg]]<ref name="Depth">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=Depth Commentary}}</ref> joined them, and the trio continued talking through Skywalker's surveil of the club crowd. After Wesell's [[Limb/Legends|arm]] was [[Dismemberment/Legends|cut off]] by Kenobi in a failed ambush, Willits passed by the bar with a drink. The bounty hunter was then removed from the club by Jedi.<ref name="aotc" />

==Personality and traits==
Willits had [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]]<ref name="IA" /> styled in meticulously scruffy dreadlocks.<ref name="Insider" /> 

==Equipment==
During his visit to the Outlander<ref name="aotc" /> in 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> he wore a [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]], a black [[Clothing/Legends|top]], a silver [[Harness/Legends|harness]], a gray [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]] with black trimming, gray pants, and black shoes.<ref name="IA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|What is it about Daro Willits that screams "unsigned musician"?|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Insider" />}}
Daro Willits first appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="aotc" /> The Outlander Club scenes including Willits, who was portrayed by an uncredited extra,<ref name="aotc" /> were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Prior to the film's release, the character was first pictured in the documentary "[[Making Episode II Webdocs|A Twinkle Beyond Pluto]],"<ref name="ATBP">{{SW|url=video/a-twinkle-beyond-pluto|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 5: A Twinkle Beyond Pluto}}</ref> released on [[July 31]], [[2001]].<ref name="ATBP Date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/me2/archive.html|text=''Making Episode II Webdocs'' archive}}</ref> Willits was first identified through the [[StarWars.com]] [[Image Attack]] feature on [[May 12]], [[2003]].<ref name="IA" />

In the article "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]," published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth]] issue of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]''<ref name="Insider" /> on [[April 6]], [[2004]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref> author [[Daniel Wallace]] mentioned Willits and asked why he resembles an unsigned [[Musician/Legends|musician]]. Wallace also brought up the character's outfit, describing it as every bit as pretentious as the outfit [[Immi Danoo]], another character in the Outlander Club scene, wears.<ref name="Insider" />
